a2t_calibration_identity_hash_convention: a2t_calibration_split_identity_hash is SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted roster 'key' values (audio2tool:<tier>:<id6>) -- the Audio2Tool probe-receipt integrity convention. a2t_calibration_flight_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)) over audio2tool/<tier>:<id6>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time. Both cover the same 500 samples; an exposure row must carry whichever value the code path that builds its ExecutionPlan computes.
a2t_calibration_key_names: The a2t_calibration_* key names are the flight-family contract scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py and scripts/a2t_calibration_prompt_fit.py read; reusing them is what lets this roster fly through the SAME entry point and the SAME FlightRuntime as every other Audio2Tool direct cell, with no new code path. The keys name a receipt-scoped roster, not the calibration split.
a2t_calibration_population: The RELEASE's own tier-1 population, sampled: for each of the 2,146 tier1_direct query_* directories the first successful speaker (on the public v1.0 release, the shipped speaker with the lowest speaker_idx, i.e. the manifest row with the lowest id), then 500 of those 2,146 drawn uniformly without replacement with seed 20260803. Builder: scripts/build_a2t_tier1_official_population_roster.py; roster receipt above; the receipt carries the directory-by-directory replay of audio_benchmark/datasets/tier1_dataset.py::_get_audio_paths that proves the equivalence. Domain mix of the draw: smart_home 368, wearables 91, smart_car 41 (population 1590 / 390 / 166). Twelve of the 500 queries are also among the 50 tier-1 queries of the frozen 400, and 11 of the 500 sample ids are already inside a committed probe-sample receipt.
a2t_calibration_d1_media_supplement: 495 of the 500 sample ids are NEW to the immutable D1 identity closure and are carried by the additive receipt named above (docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-a2t-tier1-official-population-500.json, schema saea-d1-media-supplement-v1). The other 5 (tier1_direct:000045, :000167, :001631, :002609, :002763) are already inside docs/receipts/artifacts/d1-identity.json as part of the frozen 400, and contracts.gate_media_identity refuses a supplement that duplicates a base D1 sample, so they are verified against the parent manifest and skipped. Builder: scripts/build_a2t_tier1_official_population_d1_supplement.py.
a2t_calibration_scoring_identity: 489 of the 500 sample ids are new to data.audio2tool's frozen-receipt universe and enter it through docs/receipts/probe-samples/a2t-tier1-official-population-500.json; the other 11 already resolve through r1-audio2tool-sample.json and the two 104-row post-seal AgentLoop scoring receipts, and a probe-sample receipt that repeated them would be refused as a duplicate. Without that receipt a2t-toolcall-official and a2t-toolcall-v2 refuse to score the roster at all.
a2t_calibration_exposure: Fresh discovery identities inside an already-admitted discovery carrier, prepared without model, network, tokenizer, scorer or audio-decoding contact. This fragment grants no contact authority; docs/readiness/2026-09-04-a2t-tier1-official-population-v1-preregistration.md and the exposure ledger do.
a2t_calibration_no_driver_split_name: This fragment deliberately declares no split_name key. split_id names the receipt-scoped split the calibration adapter resolves from the hash-pinned roster receipt above; it is never resolved through the generic probe-receipt universe, whose 'discovery' split_role now spans 1,097 samples.
a2t_calibration_long_row_note: One roster row is a release synthesis defect rather than a normal tier-1 item: tier1_direct:003943 (query_idx 4551, query_01972) ships a 654.6325 s wav, 18x longer than anything this repository has previously served and 39 % of the roster's whole audio budget. It is KEPT, because the released population contains it and the paper's own tier-1 row was computed over a population that contains it. The preregistration carries the contingency for a runtime that cannot serve it.
